name: prism-backtest
description: Prism Backtest runs trading strategies over daily OHLCV data the way they would have traded. Bars are fed one at a time, so a strategy can't see the future, and orders decided on a close fill at the next open. Fills pay NSE delivery or intraday charges (STT, exchange fees, SEBI fee, stamp duty, GST, DP charge) plus a half-spread and square-root market impact, and they are capped at a share of daily volume. Stops are gap-aware, and position limits, gross exposure limits and a drawdown kill switch sit between the strategy and the market. Seven built-in strategies cover trend, mean reversion, breakout, cross-sectional momentum and pairs trading. Parameter sweeps report the deflated Sharpe ratio, rolling walk-forward analysis keeps every test window out of sample, and a block bootstrap gives a distribution instead of a single equity curve. A regime-switching synthetic market with jumps and a cointegrated pair lets everything run without downloading data, and a strict CSV loader takes real data.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
